import sys
from itertools import permutations

def main():
    S = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    length = len(S)
    target_diff = int(S, 16)
    
    # Generate all possible digits from 0 to f
    digits = '0123456789abcdef'
    
    # Try all combinations of digits of the given length
    for comb in permutations(digits, length):
        num_str = ''.join(comb)
        num = int(num_str, 16)
        
        # Check all permutations of this number
        for perm in permutations(num_str):
            perm_num_str = ''.join(perm)
            perm_num = int(perm_num_str, 16)
            
            if abs(num - perm_num) == target_diff:
                # Return the smaller number with leading zeros
                return min(num_str, perm_num_str).zfill(length)
    
    return "NO"

print(main())
